# GameTools TES — macOS

## Files in this directory

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `GameTools_TES_<version>_macOS.dmg` | Disk image for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs (via Rosetta 2) |

## Installation

1. Open the `.dmg` file
2. Drag **GameTools TES** to your **Applications** folder

## First launch — Gatekeeper

macOS will block the app on first launch.

**To approve:**
1. Right-click **GameTools TES** in Applications
2. Choose **Open**
3. In the dialog, click **Open** again

Or: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Allow Anyway**

After approving once, future launches work normally.

## Usage

Launch from Applications, Spotlight, or the Dock.  
Your default browser opens automatically to the chat interface.

**First run**: Click ⚙ Settings and enter your Anthropic API key (stored securely in Keychain).

## Uninstalling

Drag **GameTools TES** to Trash.  
To remove the stored API key: **Keychain Access → search "GameTools-TES" → delete**.
